summary: Preserve namespace export-name key ordering rather than source declaration insertion order.

target.notes: String export names come from the namespace's sorted export list; Symbol.toStringTag follows according to namespace exotic semantics.

caveats: Do not reuse ordinary object insertion-order metadata for namespace string exports.

tests.name: export names sorted
tests.input:
// a.mjs: export const z=1; export const a=2
// main.mjs: import * as ns from './a.mjs'; console.log(Object.keys(ns).join(','));

tests.name: renames sort by exported name
tests.input:
// a.mjs: const x=1,y=2; export {x as q,y as b}
// main.mjs: import * as ns from './a.mjs'; console.log(Object.keys(ns).join(','));
